repo.description: The compact twin of the m0saic template starter: the minimum set of files that load in Mosaic, plus one hello-world template. Fork it, rename it, build on it.

templates.title: 01 · Hello World
templates.description: The smallest correct template: a typed props surface with deterministic defaults, an id minted with asTemplateId, outputHints as the suggested canvas, and a render() returning a validated m0 string plus one source per tile in walk order. Replace it with your first real template.

packs.title: Basics
packs.description: Your templates. hello-world shows the anatomy; replace it.
